qa_pair.question: Among the datasets this server provides, which one has a time variable on a calendar with no leap days? Answer with its dataset id.
In station_obs.nc, what is the 2 m air temperature at station number 102 at 06:00 UTC on 1 January 2026, in the units the file declares? Answer with a whole number.
In station_obs.nc, how many hourly precipitation values are missing for station number 102? Answer with an integer.
In station_obs.nc, what is the total precipitation over the whole record at station number 101, in the units the file declares? Answer with the number only, rounded to one decimal place.
In station_obs.nc, which data variable has no units attribute? Answer with the variable name.
In model_grid.nc, the precipitation flux is stored packed. What integer type is it stored as? Answer with the type name as the server reports it.
What calendar date is the first time step in model_grid.nc? Answer in YYYY-MM-DD form.
What units does the ocean profile dataset declare for salinity? Answer with the units string exactly as declared.
In the ocean profile dataset, at what depth does the temperature first fall below 10 degrees? Answer with the depth in metres, as a whole number.
In model_grid.nc, at which longitude is the near-surface air temperature highest on the first time step? Answer with the longitude in degrees east, as a whole number.
